projectAiResearch.visibilityDescription: Find brand mentions, cited pages and related questions in the provider's ChatGPT or Google AI Overview dataset. Dataset coverage depends on platform and market.
projectAiResearch.promptDescription: Compare the same prompt in selected supported models. These synthetic tests show generated answers, mentions and returned citations. They do not measure consumer ChatGPT traffic or Google AI Overview visibility.
projectAiResearch.validation: Check the brand, domain, prompt and maximum cost values.
projectAiResearch.cacheHint: Uses your connected provider. Cached results remain available for 12 hours.
projectAiResearch.requestFailure: Analysis could not be completed. Check your provider connection and review usage before trying again.
projectAiResearch.conservativeBound: Conservative admission bound: {cost} cents. This reserves the full documented model context plus bounded output because provider input overhead is unknown. Actual usage is recorded from the provider receipt.
projectAiResearch.visibilityEstimate: Estimated provider cost: {cost} cents. Your cost cap is checked before a new provider request.
projectAiResearch.emptyDescription: Estimate the cost, then run an analysis to save results to Agent Reports.
projectAiResearch.coverageDisclaimer: The provider returned no matches in this market. This does not establish that your brand is absent from every AI answer.
projectAiResearch.summary: {answers, number} answers · {mentions, number} brand mentions · {citations, number} domain citations
projectAiResearch.unknownCost: {cost} cents confirmed subtotal; total usage unknown
projectAiResearch.sample: Showing a bounded sample of {total, number} results. Counts describe the fetched answers only.
projectAiResearch.noCitations: No citations returned by this model.
projectAiResearch.partialFailure: The analysis could not be completed. Confirmed results are retained. Review provider usage before retrying.
projectAiResearch.contentTruncated: Answer excerpts are shortened to fit the saved report.
projectAiResearch.readOnly: This project is read-only or your role cannot run paid analyses. You can still open saved reports.
projectAiResearch.noSource: Connect a compatible data provider in Integrations.
projectAiResearch.unknownPrice: A bounded cost is unavailable for this model. Runs are blocked.
projectAiResearch.responseLanguageHint: An instruction for generated answers, not a dataset language filter.
projectAiResearch.tokenBounds: Allowed range: {min, number} to {max, number} tokens.
projectAiResearch.webSearchHint: Adds provider web search when supported. Cost must be estimated before running.
projectAiResearch.searchCountryHint: A country hint for web search, not a measurement of consumer traffic.
projectAiResearch.marketCoverageHint: Only countries and languages supported by the selected platform’s dataset are available.
projectAiResearch.catalogUnavailable: The provider catalog is unavailable. Check your compatible provider connection in Integrations. Saved reports remain readable.
projectAiResearch.estimateRequired: Estimate the current settings before running. Any change requires a new estimate.
projectAiResearch.estimateAboveCap: The estimate exceeds your maximum cost. Raise the cap or change the settings, then estimate again.
projectAiResearch.promptPlaceholder: Which tools help small businesses track search visibility?
projectAiResearch.pricingUnavailable: Current models are visible, but verified cost bounds are unavailable. New prompt tests are blocked until pricing can be confirmed. Saved reports remain readable.
projectAiResearch.unsupportedSettings: These settings are not supported by the current provider catalog. Refresh the page and choose supported settings before estimating again.
projectAiResearch.legacyPricingProvenance: Existing mini/nano preset: up to 512 output tokens, no web search. Admission rates last checked {date}; these are the approved preset rates, not a fresh provider quote. Estimate the cost before running.
projectAiResearch.legacyPromptLanguageHint: The existing preset sends your prompt unchanged and adds no language instruction.
projectAiResearch.catalogUnavailableLegacy: The live catalog is unavailable. The existing mini/nano preset and ChatGPT United States/English dataset preset remain available. Extended settings need a verified fresh catalog.
projectAiResearch.pricingUnavailableLegacy: Fresh bounded pricing is unavailable for extended settings. The existing 512-token mini/nano preset remains available with its dated admission rates.
projectAiResearch.modelPolicyPending: This model is awaiting a BYOK and cost-policy decision. Its published price does not enable execution.
projectAiResearch.webSearchPolicyPending: Web search is available only with an explicit BYOK actual-cost opt-in.
projectAiResearch.legacyVisibilityPreset: Existing dataset preset: ChatGPT, United States, English. Other countries, languages and platforms require the live catalog.
projectAiResearch.expandedPricingRequirement: Extended settings require a fresh verified quote before running. The existing 512-token preset rates do not quote these settings.
projectAiResearch.actualCostOwnCredentials: BYOK uses your own existing provider credentials. Hosted credentials and credits are not used in this mode.
projectAiResearch.actualCostUnavailable: Actual provider cost requires your own provider credentials and a current catalog. It is unavailable with hosted credits. The existing hard-cap preset remains available.
projectAiResearch.actualCostAcknowledgement: I accept a PARTIAL ESTIMATE without a guaranteed maximum and actual provider charges
projectAiResearch.actualCostRisk: PARTIAL ESTIMATE: tokens and provider base fees only. It excludes search tool fees, search call counts, fetched content, loop input and provider role serialization overhead. Total charges can exceed it. Your own provider credentials are billed for actual usage.
projectAiResearch.actualCostForecast: Token and base cost forecast: {cost} cents. Partial estimate with no guaranteed maximum.
projectAiResearch.actualSearchForecast: Web search requires BYOK actual-cost mode. Its tool fees and call count are not bounded by the forecast.
projectAiResearch.actualCostUsageReview: This request may have incurred a provider charge. Further paid attempts are blocked. Review provider usage and the saved report before starting another request.
projectAiResearch.credentialsChanged: The provider credentials changed after the forecast. Start a new request and obtain a new estimate before execution. No hosted credential fallback is allowed.
projectAiResearch.legacyAdmissionEstimate: Legacy admission estimate: {cost} cents, using rates checked {date}. This dated admission bound is not an unconditional guarantee of a future provider invoice. Actual usage is recorded from the provider receipt.
projectAiResearch.actualReplayHint: Repeating a completed request with the same request ID replays its saved result without a new provider call. Starting a new request can incur a new provider charge, even for the same prompt. Saved reports remain available.
